system.description:
After a successful Strike on an enemy, immediately make another Strike of the same type against it. The second Strike can't trigger Double Tap.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.41
system.summary: After a successful Strike on an enemy, immediately make another Strike of the same type against it. The second Strike can't trigger Double Tap.

automation.note: After each successful Strike, immediately Strike the same enemy again with the same weapon or attack. This extra Strike costs no action and can't trigger Double Tap.
